data.one_liner: A customizable toolbar to assist with writing Markdown in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a responsive toolbar with buttons that insert Markdown syntax into a TextField or a custom controller. Supports bold, italics, headings, lists, quotes, code, and more.
use_when: You are building a markdown editor or note-taking app in Flutter.
You need a ready-made toolbar for text formatting shortcuts.
avoid_when: You do not use Flutter's standard TextField or TextEditingController.
You require a full WYSIWYG rich text editor instead of Markdown formatting buttons.
strengths: Supports both a built-in TextField or a custom TextField and controller
weaknesses: Currently limited to working with Flutter's TextField widget
Limited support for fully custom buttons and custom functions directly via configuration properties
